usedFor: Time Doctor tracks work time, and “Create Company”, “Create Project” and “Create Task” set up what the time is for.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Moco, then “Create Company” in Time Doctor
bestTemplate.why: A new project elsewhere gets a company in Time Doctor, so tracking can start.

watchOut: Each run of “Create Company” in Time Doctor adds a company, so check the trigger to avoid duplicates.
